resources.string: Ibonisa idatha egciniweyo. Imijikelo oyigqibezelayo iza kuvumelanisa xa uphinda uxhume.
Igcinwe ungaxhunyiwe. Ikhadi lakho lamanqaku liza kulayisha ngokwayo xa uphinda uxhume.
Lo mjikelo ulindele ukuvumelanisa. Isishwankathelo siza kuvela xa sele ulayishiwe.
Izimbobo ezi-%1$d kwezi-%2$d · ilayisha xa uxhunyiwe
Imijikelo oyigqibezela ungenalo uxhulumano igcinwa kule foni kwaye ilayisha ngokwayo xa uphinda uxhume, nokuba i-TeeUp ivaliwe.
Amaxesha okudlala, imijikelo yakho neprofayile yakho zigcinwa kule foni emva kokuba zilayishiwe, ukuze usakwazi ukuzibona ungaxhunyiwe.
Uphinde waxhuma. Ilayisha ngoku imijikelo yakho egciniweyo.
Abahlobo bangabona baze bajoyine amaqela akho abahlobo kuphela, kwaye bafumana isimemo xa wenza elinye.
Abukho abahlobo okwangoku. Fumana abadlali bagolf odlala nabo ngezantsi, okanye ubongeze kwiqela olijoyinileyo.
Oko akuphumelelanga. Jonga uxhulumano lwakho uze uzame kwakhona.
Abahlobo bakho bokudlala kuphela abanokubona baze bajoyine eli qela, kwaye ngamnye ufumana isimemo sokuziswa.
